<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the unknown molecule. The only way to infer this is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals for aromatic carbons (typically in the 110‑160 ppm region). By counting those signals we can determine the aromatic carbon count.</thought>
